review_scope: Host boundary design/preparation only; no empty-scope compiler rerun by reviewer
accepted_design_points: Keep pure decode/execution/classification separate from explicit host compiler evidence.
Public driver must gate consumed audit success before returning it; a sidecar after an unauthenticated pass is insufficient.
Bind candidate Verify wrapper and actual three declaring-module scopes separately from the AxiomAudit-only empty wrapper.
Verify is the executing wrapper identity, not an imported theorem declaration.
Reuse matching observed evidence without mandatory signing or per-certificate recompilation; preserve source/library refinement limits.

root_qualifications.detail: Caller-supplied files/logs with matching path/hash/counts do not prove a compiler ran. Reuse requires evidence whose execution provenance is trusted by the host, such as its own recorded successful process for the same identity tuple. An unknown supplied record must cause actual compiler verification or no discharge. Do not treat file-backed versus JSON as an authentication boundary.

Preserve pure untrusted classification only when explicitly distinguished from compiler discharge. The public advertised audit success consumed by callers and F44 scoring must be host-validated; do not merely rename the same unauthenticated pass.

F45 concerns actual claimed coverage under declaring-module scope, not proof that every transitive import excludes every forbidden namespace. Do not broaden it into a new whole-repository import prohibition.

The hash in the root receipt is the Lean launcher. Pin the complete compiler installation/dependency identity or explicitly bind the actual version/build and runtime libraries used, rather than claiming launcher bytes alone identify all executed compiler code.

scope_limits: Grok verified copied hashes and toolchain version; it did not replay the empty-scope compilation.
Complete report files are preserved despite capped native termination. This is advisory design evidence, not a clean native end or full candidate acceptance.
